mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Temperatures are at 54 degrees with mainly clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a full moon visible. Please note that the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona has released information regarding the proposed 2027 annual budget. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to review several development projects on November 4, including the Ardent Glen third addition and site plans for 1979 Milky Way.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus Brewing or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, don't miss the Main Street Trick or Treat event on October 29.

On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired after receiving reports of dangerous driving. No injuries occurred, and the incident remains under investigation.
Today's flavor of the day is Pumpkin Pecan. The restaurant is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
